related_work.work_intent_goal: exercise canonical Environment persistence through the Control socket
related_work.campaign_objective: MNCS Environmental Capability Intelligence & Continuous Improvement Campaign

outcome.implementation_change: When the selected session has explicit workspace read authority and a complete root scan, the projection can perform one bounded targeted discovery for an otherwise unselected referenced repository. It reads only the referenced committed blob, checks its SHA-256, caches the resolved checkout per projection, and does not add that repository to selected or writable scope.
outcome.analysis_limit: The readback verifies availability and integrity of one authentic Compiler evidence pointer. It does not add missing cgroup measurements, validate current VM inputs, establish recurrence, or demonstrate downstream Compiler-agent use.

improvement_relation.basis: The focused tests verify the positive read-only workspace path, one targeted discovery reused for two pointers, SHA-256 mismatch detection, denial without workspace read authority, refusal of an incomplete root scan, and refusal of a checkout outside the trusted root. The live campaign projection content-verifies the authentic Compiler source pointer while leaving Compiler unselected and unwritable.
not_measured: recurrence of this source-discovery pressure across later sessions
whether the verified cross-repository evidence changes Compiler implementation decisions
whether resource attribution and stale VM provenance limitations persist
whether subsequent Compiler activity can resolve or narrow the original pressure hypothesis
resource and token cost of the read-only repository discovery path
